Job Description:

ITW Food Equipment Group LLC designs and manufactures commercial food equipment for food service and retail customers through its subsidiaries. The company’s products include ware washing equipment; cooking equipment, including ovens, ranges, and broilers; refrigeration equipment, including refrigerators, freezers, and prep tables; food processing equipment, including slicers, mixers, and scales; and kitchen exhaust, ventilation, and pollution control systems. ITW FEG has the largest service network in this industry to support our global customers, with highly specialized technicians and best-in-class supply chain procedures. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Troy, Ohio. ITW Food Equipment Group LLC is an Illinois Tool Works Inc. subsidiary.

SUMMARY
The Service Territory Operations Manager is responsible and accountable for leading and directing their assigned territory to achieve Service Annual Plan commitments and deliver ongoing service revenue growth, profitability, productivity, quality, and service levels. The Service Territory Operations Manager is also responsible for maintaining relationships across the Food Equipment Group enterprise including Field Sales Managers, Territory Installation Managers, Equipment sales teams, and major dealers who support FEG growth. The STOM ensures that the strategic direction for Service, as defined in Annual and Long-Range Plans, is carried out by the District Managers and territory Administrative/Customer Support functions per ITW’s policies and applicable laws .

- STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP: Support and implement goals aligned with the business's long-term plan, segmentation, and strategic direction as communicated by the Service Division Leadership team.  Drive the overall success of the territory. Anticipate local trends and implications accurately to create sustainable value.

- ACTION ORIENTED: Identify and seize new opportunities through strategic initiatives. Analyze performance data to recommend productivity, profitability, and customer satisfaction improvements.

- CUSTOMER FOCUS: Cultivate external relationships with clients and vendors, manage peer and territory-level customer relationships strategically, build solid connections, and ensure the delivery of customer-centric solutions aligned with strategic goals to reduce conflict and grow the business.

- BUILD NETWORKS: Collaborate with the Service Sales, National Accounts, Installation & Equipment Sales team in the territory to achieve service strategic objectives and support shared strategic objectives.  Recommends and makes data-driven strategic trade-off decisions within the territory. Maintains awareness of market dynamics impacting the districts.

- FINANCIAL ACUMEN: Manage the P&L of the business strategically. Use financial analysis to generate, evaluate, and act on strategic options and opportunities.

- STRATEGIC MINDSET:    Demonstrate ability to analyze data and apply it to organizational strategies, drive simplification to all levels of the organization, be the point of contact for escalation concerns within the territory and be able to resolve complex issues strategically that impact current and future business needs.

With over $15.9 billion in revenue (2024), ITW operates with a decentralized business model focused on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and strong talent development across its global footprint.

ITW Specialty Films manufactures and markets specialized coated and metallized films used in Secure ID, Medical Specialty Bags, Financial Cards, Laminations, and Holographic applications. With multiple manufacturing facilities in the US, UK, and Germany, the division leverages core competencies in films, foils, holography, and laminates to meet complex customer needs.

jobs.location: Glenview, Illinois, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description:

ITW Construction North American provides solutions that build the spaces where we all live and work. Across the residential, commercial and renovation markets, we lead the construction industry in manufacturing a variety of products for wood, engineered lumber, concrete and steel. At ITW, we offer you a path for advancement, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to help employees care for themselves, their families, and their futures.

Purpose of the Role

As the IT Operations Manager, North America, you are responsible for security, systems, and technology delivery while providing IT thought leadership and direction for our platform, which includes 600+ employees operating across multiple facilities within the US. You will lead day‑to‑day IT operations for our North American businesses, work closely with Corporate IT to align with enterprise strategy and compliance requirements, and partner with business leaders to ensure technology effectively supports strategic goals, drives results, and improves business processes. In addition, you will oversee the operational and security aspects of IT Applications and infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

- Architecture Strategy & Alignment - Develop and implement a cohesive regional IT infrastructure strategy aligned with the Enterprise and Segment’s objectives, ensuring it accommodates the unique requirements of each division and plant.
- Standardize the IT architecture across divisions, integrating systems while ensuring minimal disruption to plant operations.
- Critical partner in overall ERP & Financial Data Management and will play a critical role in the implementation of all future business systems and tools

- Infrastructure Management   - Manage the regional IT infrastructure, ensuring high availability, reliability, and performance across all manufacturing plants.
- Oversee the implementation of networks, data centers, cloud solutions, and other infrastructure components across the region.
- Ensure proper maintenance, upgrading, and lifecycle management of IT hardware and software at each site.
- Lead initiatives to migrate and integrate legacy systems where feasible, balancing cost and operational efficiency.
- Lead IT infrastructure assessments and due diligence for consolidation and simplification.
- Develop roadmaps for unifying disparate IT environments, ensuring seamless connectivity and data flow between systems.
- Maintain operational continuity while driving the transition from legacy systems to modern, consolidated architecture.

- Identity and Access Management   - Oversee regional identity management systems, ensuring secure and efficient access control.
- Provide guidelines and supervise MSPs managing and maintaining account provisioning and trust relationships between legacy and modern systems.
- Lead effort to standardize IAM practices integrating disparate identify systems
- Implement robust authentication methods including single sign-on (SSO) multifactor authentication (MFA) and role-based access control (RBAC)
- Ensure compliance with data protection regulations (i.e. GDRP, CCPA) and internal policies related to identity and access management
- Perform regular audits and reviews of access permissions to identify and mitigate security risks

- Collaboration with Stakeholders - Build cross-department credibility, confidence, and collaboration with other functional areas within the Divisions via IT business partnership
- Work closely with manufacturing plant leadership, division heads, and other stakeholders to understand operational requirements and ensure IT solutions meet business needs.
- Keeps the organization’s vision and values at the forefront of decision-making and action

- Cybersecurity & Compliance   - Ensure all regional IT systems and infrastructure comply with ITW IT security policy.
- Work with Corporate cyber security team to implement best practices for protecting critical manufacturing systems from cyber threats.
- Conduct regular audits, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing across regional IT environments.

- Team Leadership & Vendor Management   - Builds and develops high-performing teams through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and targeted talent development initiatives.
- Provide guidance, mentorship, and professional development.
- Manage relationships with external vendors, contractors, and service providers to ensure the timely and cost-effective delivery of IT services.
- Oversee contracts and service-level agreements (SLAs) for infrastructure-related services in the region.

- Performance Monitoring & Reporting  - Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to track the performance and health of regional IT systems.
- Prepare regular reports for senior leadership, highlighting system performance, project progress, and any issues or risks.
- Implement tools and processes for proactive monitoring, issue detection, and problem resolution across IT environments.

- Innovation & Continuous Improvement  - Stay updated with the latest industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IT infrastructure, cloud computing, and manufacturing technology.
- Proactively identify opportunities to enhance system efficiency, reduce costs, and support manufacturing innovation (e.g., IoT, AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics in production environments).
- Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives that explore the potential benefits of new technologies.

Required Qualifications

- - Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science or related field of study
- 10+ years of IT experience with background in managing IT infrastructures in a multi-site context
- 3 years as a manager with direct reports
- 2 years with direct relationship management of major IT third-party vendors
- Experience in partnership supporting ERP systems
- Ability to utilize data to help determine focus and strategy
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to present operational status to senior leadership
- Must be able to multi-task, work under pressure and meet deadlines
- Demonstrated accountability for results and understanding of the financial impact of decisions with experience managing operational budgets and cost control
- Ability to travel domestically up to 10%

Technical Skills:
- - Network architecture, hardware
- Data center management
- Identity management
- Cloud computing

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a manufacturing environment

Job Description:

OPERATIONS DIRECTOR – MECHANICAL FASTENING

About ITW Mechanical Fastening
ITW Mechanical Fastening, a division of ITW Construction Products, is a global provider of premium fastening solutions that improve contractor productivity and building quality in the residential and renovation construction industries. Our portfolio includes category-leading brands such as GRK Fasteners™, Tapcon®, Red Head®, Ramset®, Rock-On®, Backer-On®, Teks®, and E-Z Ancor®. These trusted solutions help contractors work more efficiently while delivering superior performance on the jobsite.

About ITW
Founded in 1912, Illinois Tool Works Inc. is a Fortune 300 global multi-industry manufacturing leader with revenue of $16 billion in 2025. The company's seven industry-leading segments leverage the unique ITW Business Model to drive solid growth with best-in-class margins and returns in markets where highly innovative, customer-focused solutions are required. ITW's approximately 43,000 dedicated colleagues around the world thrive in the company's decentralized and entrepreneurial culture. ITW .

Why This Role Matters
As a key divisional leader, the Operations Director is responsible for developing and executing the long-term operations strategy that enables profitable growth across a significant business within the Construction segment. This role drives operational excellence by ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality products, in the right quantities to meet customer demand, while optimizing cost, productivity, and profitability in alignment with ITW's enterprise objectives.
The Operations Director provides strategic leadership and oversight across manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, manufacturing engineering, safety, and quality functions spanning five locations (with the greater Chicago area). By leveraging ITW's business model and continuous improvement principles, the role ensures operational capabilities support growth, enhance customer satisfaction, and deliver sustainable business performance.

What You Will Do

- Develop and execute manufacturing strategies that ensure safe, efficient operations and consistent delivery of high-quality products.
- Establish and monitor key performance metrics to drive continuous improvement and exceed operational targets.
- Lead cross-functional quality initiatives, strengthen supplier accountability, and improve supplier and end-of-line quality performance.
- Oversee capital planning and execute operational CAPEX projects that enhance productivity, capacity, and growth.
- Partner with segment sourcing and supply chain teams to optimize supply chain and distribution performance.
- Drive productivity improvements and cost reductions through the application of the ITW Toolbox and continuous improvement principles.
- Manage supply chain performance through strategic sourcing, supplier partnerships, inventory optimization, and transportation cost control.
- Improve conversion costs by reducing waste, scrap, rework, and other operational inefficiencies.
- Enhance delivery performance and inventory optimization through strong MRD practices across manufactured and purchased products.
- Drive collaboration with engineering, marketing, and sourcing teams to ensure successful new product introductions on time and on cost.
- Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and company standards.
- Foster a high-performance culture through effective communication, employee engagement, coaching, and leadership development.
- Build organizational capability by developing Operations, Engineering, and Supply Chain leaders and driving succession planning.
- Champion a world-class safety culture through proactive risk identification, mitigation, and employee accountability.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

What You Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
- 15+ years of progressive operations leadership experience in complex manufacturing environments, including multi-site responsibility.
- Proven success leading manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, warehousing, and safety functions while delivering strong business and financial results.
- Demonstrated ability to develop and execute operational strategies that drive growth, productivity, customer service, and margin improvement.
- Strong financial and business acumen, including experience managing budgets, capital investments, cost reduction, and operational performance metrics.
- Proven track record of building high-performing teams, developing leaders, and driving organizational capability through coaching and succession planning.
- Experience leading supply chain optimization, supplier quality improvement, and large-scale operational or business transformation initiatives.
- Strong change management, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence and drive results across organizational boundaries.
- Deep commitment to safety, quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, with experience relevant operating disciplines.
- Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to effectively engage employees, customers, suppliers, and senior leadership.
- Willingness to travel regularly to operating locations, with occasional international travel as needed.

What's In It for You

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity to shape the operational strategy and long-term success of a significant business within ITW's Construction segment. As a key member of the Division Leadership Team, you will have the autonomy to drive operational excellence across multiple sites while influencing business performance, customer satisfaction, and profitable growth. You will lead a diverse organization spanning manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, engineering, quality, and safety, while leveraging the ITW Business Model to deliver meaningful results.Beyond driving business outcomes, you will have the opportunity to build high-performing teams, develop the next generation of operations leaders, and lead transformational initiatives that create lasting impact across the organization. Most importantly, you will be part of ITW's unique entrepreneurial culture, where leaders are empowered to make decisions, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Guided by ITW's core values of Integrity, Respect, Trust, Shared Risk, and Simplicity, you will help foster an environment where people thrive, customers succeed, and businesses grow sustainably.  Learn more at ITW Careers .

Work Environment

This position is based in our Glenview corporate office; however, the employee may be required to work in a variety of locations, including but not limited to construction/job sites, supplier locations, test laboratories, and manufacturing facilities. These environments may not be controlled by the Company and may require the use of personal protective equipment (PPE). While performing the duties of this position, the employee may occasionally be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, climate variations, and moving mechanical equipment typically found in construction and manufacturing environments. The noise level in the corporate office is generally low; however, noise levels may be significantly higher when visiting job sites, test laboratories, or manufacturing facilities. The ITW Fluids North America Division is a manufacturer of lubricants, cleaning chemicals, and corrosion preventatives formulated to maximize equipment productivity and product quality for customers. ITW Fluids Division includes five facilities in the United States and is a division of Illinois Tool Works, a Fortune 150 company.  We go to market through B2B with a focus on the automotive, aviation, fabricated metal, food processing and machinery manufacturing market segments. Offering a brand portfolio that is well recognized within these industrial channels, our premium products address customer pain points and our direct sales team provide expert value-added consulting at the customer level. ITW Pro Brands has 250 employees and 4 manufacturing facilities in: Olathe, KS, Tucker, GA, Easton, MD, and DeWitt, IA.

Our Values:
- Simplicity : focusing on the essential core of each business opportunity, guided by the “80/20” rule to streamline processes, systems and structures.
- Shared risk : collaborating as a team, taking joint responsibility, and learning from trial and error to drive innovation.
- Integrity : honesty, transparency, and doing the right thing in all business dealings, regardless of brand and location.
- Respect : valuing diversity in cultural backgrounds and fostering an open environment where innovation can thrive.
- Trust : relying on employees to uphold the highest professional standards and act in the company’s best interests.

What We Offer:
ITW’s benefits package is designed to provide comprehensive support for physical, mental, and financial well-being including healthcare, retirement planning, paid leave, wellness programs, and opportunities for charitable involvement.

Position Summary :
The Director of Operations provides overall direction, strategy, and planning for the division’s manufacturing facilities.  The Director of Operations, in partnership with the Plant Managers, will have overall responsibility for manufacturing operations at each facility to include manufacturing, shipping/receiving, quality, regulatory, EHS, maintenance, engineering, strategic sourcing and customer service.

Core Responsibilities
- Develop team members through coaching, feedback, and performance reviews
- Promote a strong culture of quality, safety, and environmental compliance
- Set strategic direction to improve profitability, productivity, and efficiency
- Define site goals and ensure effective use of resources
- Build and execute functional strategies and annual plans with site and EHS leaders
- Partner across teams on innovation and new product development
- Drive continuous improvement using established tools and practices by championing ITW toolbox initiatives for manufacturing operations.
- Direct and report on performance against operational metrics: Safety/Cost/ Quality
- Lead global sourcing efforts to meet division goals
